variations.name: just be around any people
variations.description: Could be driven by a desires for simple companionship, social validation, or general social stimulation.

variations.name: be around certain people
variations.description: Could be driven by a desire to meet someone special or gain the favor of a certain social group.

variations.name: gossip bond
variations.description: Gossip is a form of social contact that helps reinforce group bonds and the understanding of the social network. It may also bring status.

commentaries.quote: Loneliness is a little different in that you can be surrounded by social activity and still feel unrecognized.

conditions: A drive to become more socially active, predicting that doing so would bring benefits.
